text: The Fed just hiked rates to 3.75%-4% while September payrolls badly missed at just 29,000 jobs versus 84,000 expected — this is a dangerous combo of tightening into a weakening labor market, which raises recession risk and means you should be cautious about adding new positions right now.
Raise your BMNR stop from $21.33 to $22.40 to lock in more protection, since three consecutive earnings misses and weak relative strength mean you want a tighter safety net on this one.

Adobe looks compelling at a PE of just 8.7 with over 10% revenue growth and strong free cash flow — consider adding to this position on any pullback toward support, though be measured given the uncertain macro backdrop.
UnitedHealth trades at a reasonable PE of 16.4 with nearly 12% revenue growth and insiders are buying with their own money, which is a confidence signal — consider adding a small amount here.
